Ownable.owner - privileged address controlling owner-only functions
ENSConsumer.ensRegistry - address of the ENS registry used for external calls
BaseWallet.methodToModule - selector to module binding used by fallback
QuotaStore.quotas - rolling spending quota per wallet
WhitelistStore.effectiveTimeMap - wallet to address to whitelist effective time
AddressSet.sets - generic address sets with positions
Controller.walletFactory - factory authorized to initialize wallets
ControllerImpl.priceOracle - oracle used for gas fee valuation
recipient.call{value: amount, gas: gasLimit}("") - arbitrary ETH transfer
target.delegatecall(data) - delegatecall from wallet execution context
target.call{value: value}(data) - arbitrary external call with value

assembly call(gasLimit, to, value, ...) with returndatacopy in AddressUtil.fastCall

a - b subtraction guarded by SUB_UNDERFLOW require in MathUint.sub

BaseModule.deactivate - unbinds methods for logicalSender wallet

SecurityStore.setInheritor - sets inheritor and refreshes lastActive
QuotaStore.addToSpent - updates spent amount and timestamp
WhitelistStore.addToWhitelist - onlyWalletModule whitelist with effective time
